source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "idRow", "sql": "SELECT 'ord-' || (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1)::text AS id FROM wt_order WHERE warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_order (id, warehouse_id, order_no, order_type, status, priority, lines_count, due_at) VALUES (?, 'wh-rc01', ?, ?, CASE WHEN ? = 'inbound' THEN 'planned' ELSE 'queued' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'normal'), GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::integer, 1), 1), COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::timestamptz, NOW() + interval '6 hours'))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.orderNo}", "${input.orderType}", "${input.orderType}", "${input.priority}", "${input.linesCount}", "${input.dueAt}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_kpi SET value = value + 1 WHERE key = 'ordersActive'"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "created", "sql": "SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, order_no AS \"orderNo\", order_type AS \"orderType\", status, priority, lines_count AS \"linesCount\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_order WHERE id = ?) t", "params": ["${idRow.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${created.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "idRow", "sql": "SELECT 't-' || (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1)::text AS id FROM wt_task WHERE warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_task (id, warehouse_id, title, task_type, status, priority, assignee, location_code, source_location_code, sku_code, qty, order_id, due_at) VALUES (?, 'wh-rc01', ?, 'putaway', CASE WHEN NULLIF(?, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'queued' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'normal'), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?::integer, 0), NULLIF(?, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::timestamptz, NOW() + interval '6 hours'))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.title}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.priority}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.targetLocation}", "${input.sourceLocation}", "${input.skuCode}", "${input.qty}", "${input.orderId}", "${input.dueAt}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_kpi SET value = value + 1 WHERE key = 'tasksOpen'"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "created", "sql": "SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, title, task_type AS \"taskType\", status, priority, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(location_code,'') AS \"locationCode\", COALESCE(source_location_code,'') AS \"sourceLocationCode\", COALESCE(sku_code,'') AS \"skuCode\", qty, COALESCE(order_id,'') AS \"orderId\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_task WHERE id = ?) t", "params": ["${idRow.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${created.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "idRow", "sql": "SELECT 't-' || (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1)::text AS id FROM wt_task WHERE warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_task (id, warehouse_id, title, task_type, status, priority, assignee, location_code, source_location_code, sku_code, qty, due_at) VALUES (?, 'wh-rc01', ?, 'replenish', CASE WHEN NULLIF(?, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'queued' END, 'normal', NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?::integer, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::timestamptz, NOW() + interval '4 hours'))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.title}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.targetLocation}", "${input.sourceLocation}", "${input.skuCode}", "${input.qty}", "${input.dueAt}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_kpi SET value = value + 1 WHERE key = 'tasksOpen'"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "created", "sql": "SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, title, task_type AS \"taskType\", status, priority, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(location_code,'') AS \"locationCode\", COALESCE(source_location_code,'') AS \"sourceLocationCode\", COALESCE(sku_code,'') AS \"skuCode\", qty, COALESCE(order_id,'') AS \"orderId\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_task WHERE id = ?) t", "params": ["${idRow.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${created.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "idRow", "sql": "SELECT 't-' || (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1)::text AS id FROM wt_task WHERE warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_task (id, warehouse_id, title, task_type, status, priority, assignee, location_code, source_location_code, sku_code, qty, order_id, due_at) VALUES (?, 'wh-rc01', ?, ?, CASE WHEN NULLIF(?, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'queued' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'normal'), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?::integer, 0), NULLIF(?, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::timestamptz, NOW() + interval '4 hours'))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.title}", "${input.taskType}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.priority}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.locationCode}", "${input.sourceLocationCode}", "${input.skuCode}", "${input.qty}", "${input.orderId}", "${input.dueAt}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_kpi SET value = value + 1 WHERE key = 'tasksOpen'"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "created", "sql": "SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, title, task_type AS \"taskType\", status, priority, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(location_code,'') AS \"locationCode\", COALESCE(source_location_code,'') AS \"sourceLocationCode\", COALESCE(sku_code,'') AS \"skuCode\", qty, COALESCE(order_id,'') AS \"orderId\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_task WHERE id = ?) t", "params": ["${idRow.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${created.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "idRow", "sql": "SELECT 'wave-' || (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1)::text AS id FROM wt_wave WHERE warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "stats", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS oc, COALESCE(SUM(o.lines_count), 0)::integer AS lc FROM wt_order o WHERE o.warehouse_id = ? AND o.id IN (SELECT json_array_elements_text(?::json))", "params": ["wh-rc01", "${input.orderIdsJson}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_wave (id, warehouse_id, wave_no, status, priority, order_count, line_count, assignee, due_at) VALUES (?, 'wh-rc01', ?, 'planned', COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'normal'), COALESCE(?::integer, 0), COALESCE(?::integer, 0), NULLIF(?, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::timestamptz, NOW() + interval '8 hours'))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.waveNo}", "${input.priority}", "${stats.oc}", "${stats.lc}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.dueAt}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_wave_order (wave_id, order_id) SELECT ?, json_array_elements_text(?::json)", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.orderIdsJson}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_audit_log (id, warehouse_id, entity_type, entity_id, action, detail, actor) VALUES ('aud-' || extract(epoch from now())::bigint, 'wh-rc01', 'wave', ?, 'created', ?, NULLIF(?, ''))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.waveNo}", "${input.actor}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "created", "sql": "SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT w.id, w.wave_no AS \"waveNo\", w.status, w.priority, w.order_count AS \"orderCount\", w.line_count AS \"lineCount\", COALESCE(w.assignee, '') AS assignee, w.created_at AS \"createdAt\", w.released_at AS \"releasedAt\", w.due_at AS \"dueAt\", COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(wo.order_id)::text FROM wt_wave_order wo WHERE wo.wave_id = w.id), '[]') AS \"orderIdsJson\" FROM wt_wave w WHERE w.id = ?) t", "params": ["${idRow.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${created.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(key, value)::text, '{}') AS rows FROM wt_kpi"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, code, name, address, area_m2 AS \"areaM2\", status FROM wt_warehouse WHERE id = 'wh-rc01') t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, entity_type AS \"entityType\", entity_id AS \"entityId\", action, COALESCE(detail, '') AS detail, COALESCE(actor, '') AS actor, created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_audit_log WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, code, name, eq_type AS \"eqType\", status, zone_label AS \"zoneLabel\", battery, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\" FROM wt_equipment WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT i.id, i.location_code AS \"locationCode\", i.sku_code AS \"skuCode\", i.sku_name AS \"skuName\", i.qty, i.uom, i.lot, i.expiry_date AS \"expiryDate\", (i.expiry_date::date - CURRENT_DATE) AS \"daysLeft\", CASE WHEN i.expiry_date::date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'expired' WHEN i.expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE + 3 THEN 'critical' WHEN i.expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE + 14 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'ok' END AS \"fefoStatus\" FROM wt_inventory i WHERE i.warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' AND i.expiry_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.expiry_date ASC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, title, severity, status, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(source,'') AS source, COALESCE(equipment_id,'') AS \"equipmentId\", COALESCE(location_code,'') AS \"locationCode\", created_at AS \"createdAt\", sla_due_at AS \"slaDueAt\" FROM wt_incident WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY created_at DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, protocol, health, latency_ms AS \"latencyMs\", COALESCE(endpoint,'') AS endpoint, COALESCE(description,'') AS description, last_sync_at AS \"lastSyncAt\" FROM wt_integration ORDER BY name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, location_code AS \"locationCode\", sku_code AS \"skuCode\", sku_name AS \"skuName\", qty, uom, lot, expiry_date AS \"expiryDate\" FROM wt_inventory WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY location_code, sku_code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT series, label, value, sort_order AS \"sortOrder\" FROM wt_kpi_point WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY sort_order, label) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, location_code AS \"locationCode\", zone_id AS \"zoneId\", aisle, rack, level, status, fill_pct AS \"fillPct\", sku_count AS \"skuCount\" FROM wt_location WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY location_code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, order_no AS \"orderNo\", order_type AS \"orderType\", status, priority, lines_count AS \"linesCount\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_order WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY created_at DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, wave_id AS \"waveId\", sort_order AS \"sortOrder\", location_code AS \"locationCode\" FROM wt_pick_route WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY wave_id, sort_order) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS \"orderNo\", o.status, o.lines_count AS \"linesCount\", o.priority, o.due_at AS \"dueAt\", 'R-DOCK-1' AS \"dockLocation\", (SELECT l.location_code FROM wt_location l WHERE l.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id AND l.zone_id = 'z-rack' AND l.status IN ('ready','occupied') ORDER BY l.fill_pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS \"suggestLocation\" FROM wt_order o WHERE o.warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' AND o.order_type = 'inbound' AND o.status IN ('planned','receiving') ORDER BY o.due_at) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT sku_code AS \"skuCode\", sku_name AS \"skuName\", pick_qty AS \"pickQty\", bulk_qty AS \"bulkQty\", min_stock AS \"minStock\", need_qty AS \"needQty\", source_location AS \"sourceLocation\", target_location AS \"targetLocation\" FROM (SELECT s.sku_code, s.sku_name, s.min_stock, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM wt_inventory i JOIN wt_location l ON l.location_code = i.location_code WHERE i.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND i.sku_code = s.sku_code AND l.zone_id = 'z-pick'), 0)::integer AS pick_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM wt_inventory i JOIN wt_location l ON l.location_code = i.location_code WHERE i.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND i.sku_code = s.sku_code AND l.zone_id IN ('z-rack','z-bulk')), 0)::integer AS bulk_qty, GREATEST(s.min_stock - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM wt_inventory i JOIN wt_location l ON l.location_code = i.location_code WHERE i.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND i.sku_code = s.sku_code AND l.zone_id = 'z-pick'), 0), 0)::integer AS need_qty, (SELECT i.location_code FROM wt_inventory i JOIN wt_location l ON l.location_code = i.location_code WHERE i.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND i.sku_code = s.sku_code AND l.zone_id IN ('z-rack','z-bulk') ORDER BY i.qty DESC LIMIT 1) AS source_location, (SELECT l.location_code FROM wt_location l WHERE l.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND l.zone_id = 'z-pick' ORDER BY l.fill_pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS target_location FROM wt_sku s WHERE s.warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01') x WHERE need_qty > 0 AND bulk_qty > 0 ORDER BY need_qty DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, sku_code AS \"skuCode\", sku_name AS \"skuName\", abc_class AS \"abcClass\", storage_zone AS \"storageZone\", uom, shelf_life_days AS \"shelfLifeDays\", min_stock AS \"minStock\" FROM wt_sku WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY sku_code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, title, task_type AS \"taskType\", status, priority, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(location_code,'') AS \"locationCode\", COALESCE(source_location_code,'') AS \"sourceLocationCode\", COALESCE(sku_code,'') AS \"skuCode\", qty, COALESCE(order_id,'') AS \"orderId\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_task WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY created_at DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, email, role FROM wt_user WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT w.id, w.wave_no AS \"waveNo\", w.status, w.priority, w.order_count AS \"orderCount\", w.line_count AS \"lineCount\", COALESCE(w.assignee, '') AS assignee, w.created_at AS \"createdAt\", w.released_at AS \"releasedAt\", w.due_at AS \"dueAt\", COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(wo.order_id)::text FROM wt_wave_order wo WHERE wo.wave_id = w.id), '[]') AS \"orderIdsJson\" FROM wt_wave w WHERE w.warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, warehouse_id AS \"warehouseId\", label, zone_type AS \"zoneType\", x, y, w, h FROM wt_zone WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' ORDER BY label) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "idRow", "sql": "SELECT 'aud-' || (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1)::text AS id FROM wt_audit_log WHERE warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wt_audit_log (id, warehouse_id, entity_type, entity_id, action, detail, actor) VALUES (?, 'wh-rc01', ?, ?, ?, NULLIF(?, ''), NULLIF(?, ''))", "params": ["${idRow.id}", "${input.entityType}", "${input.entityId}", "${input.action}", "${input.detail}", "${input.actor}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "{}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'health', 'online', 'latencyMs', latency_ms + 12, 'pingAt', NOW())::text, '{}') AS rows FROM wt_integration WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_zone z SET x = (e->>'x')::double precision, y = (e->>'y')::double precision, w = (e->>'w')::double precision, h = (e->>'h')::double precision, label = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(e->>'label'), ''), z.label) FROM json_array_elements(?::json) AS e WHERE z.id = e->>'id' AND z.warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01'", "params": ["${input.zonesJson}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_equipment eq SET pos_x = (e->>'posX')::double precision, pos_y = (e->>'posY')::double precision FROM json_array_elements(?::json) AS e WHERE eq.id = e->>'id' AND eq.warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01'", "params": ["${input.equipmentJson}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "{}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_order o SET status = ? WHERE o.id = ? AND o.warehouse_id = ? AND ((o.order_type = 'inbound' AND o.status = 'planned' AND ? IN ('receiving', 'cancelled')) OR (o.order_type = 'inbound' AND o.status = 'receiving' AND ? IN ('received', 'cancelled')) OR (o.order_type = 'outbound' AND o.status = 'queued' AND ? IN ('picking', 'cancelled')) OR (o.order_type = 'outbound' AND o.status = 'picking' AND ? IN ('shipped', 'cancelled')))", "params": ["${input.status}", "${input.orderId}", "wh-rc01", "${input.status}", "${input.status}", "${input.status}", "${input.status}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "after", "sql": "SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, order_no AS \"orderNo\", order_type AS \"orderType\", status, priority, lines_count AS \"linesCount\", due_at AS \"dueAt\", created_at AS \"createdAt\" FROM wt_order WHERE id = ? AND warehouse_id = ?) t", "params": ["${input.orderId}", "wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_kpi SET value = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wt_order WHERE warehouse_id = 'wh-rc01' AND status NOT IN ('shipped', 'received', 'cancelled')) WHERE key = 'ordersActive'"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${after.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_task t SET status = ?, assignee = CASE WHEN NULLIF(?, '') IS NOT NULL THEN ? ELSE t.assignee END WHERE t.id = ? AND t.warehouse_id = ? AND ((t.status = 'queued' AND ? IN ('assigned', 'cancelled')) OR (t.status = 'assigned' AND ? IN ('in_progress', 'cancelled')) OR (t.status = 'in_progress' AND ? IN ('done', 'cancelled')))", "params": ["${input.status}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.taskId}", "wh-rc01", "${input.status}", "${input.status}", "${input.status}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_order o SET status = CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'inbound' AND o.status = 'planned' THEN 'receiving' WHEN o.order_type = 'outbound' AND o.status = 'queued' THEN 'picking' ELSE o.status END FROM wt_task t WHERE t.id = ? AND t.order_id = o.id AND t.status = 'in_progress' AND o.warehouse_id = ?", "params": ["${input.taskId}", "wh-rc01"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wt_order o SET status = CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'outbound' AND o.status = 'picking' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wt_task tk WHERE tk.order_id = o.id AND tk.status NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')) THEN 'shipped' WHEN o.order_type = 'inbound' AND o.status = 'receiving' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wt_task tk WHERE tk.order_id = o.id AND tk.status NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')) THEN 'received' ELSE o.status END WHERE o.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM wt_task WHERE id = ?
